name: SplatLoc Descriptor Learning & Landmark Selection
definition: A visual localization and novel view rendering approach that learns an unbiased 3D descriptor field for reconstructed Gaussian primitives, selects salient 3D landmarks via greedy search, and applies position/scale regularization to key primitives.
summary: SplatLoc learns unbiased 3D descriptors via explicit decoders and multi-resolution encoding, selecting salient landmarks to achieve superior localization accuracy and rendering quality over neural implicit baselines.
